name: OSS_BALANCE_ADJUSTMENTS
description: Balance Adjustments table stores the Adjustments of Balances for Subscription Product.

columns.name: BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of Balance Adjustment

columns.name: BALANCE_ADJUSTMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Alternate identifier of Balance Adjustment

columns.name: ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Entitlement that is getting Adjusted. It can be Allowance, Estimate, Commitment.

columns.name: ENTITLEMENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier of Entitlement Record

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier to Subscription Product.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier to Balance Register.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier to Balance Register Period.

columns.name: CHARGE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier to Charge Line.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key Identifier to Balance Code Id.

columns.name: BALANCE_CODE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Balance Code. It can be Amount or Quantity.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Field used to capture currency code.

columns.name: BAL_ADJ_PARTIAL_PERIOD_OPT
columns.description: The method that determines how the adjustment needs to be given for partial period.

columns.name: BAL_ADJ_TERM_PTL_PERIOD_OPT
columns.description: The method that determines how the adjustment needs to be given for terminated partial period.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_NAME
columns.description: User-defined name or label to identify and categorize the specific adjustment record.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Detailed description of the adjustment reason or context for audit and reporting.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for Adjustment. Extensible Lookup values.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Specifies the nature of adjustment, such as markup, markdown, or manual correction.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the adjustment. Can be percentage value or absolute value based on ADJUSTMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_QUANTITY
columns.description: Entitlement quantity changed as part of the adjustment process.

columns.name: TERMINATED_QUANTITY
columns.description: Adjusted quantity that got terminated as part of subscription product termination.

columns.name: NET_ADJUSTED_QUANTITY
columns.description: Final Adjusted Quantity for the current period.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Entitlement amount changed as part of the adjustment process.

columns.name: TERMINATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjusted amount that got terminated as part of subscription product termination.

columns.name: NET_ADJUSTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Final Adjusted Amount for the current period.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence Number of the adjustment record created.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
